misconceptions.description: Choosing text and background colors that fail contrast requirements
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses light gray text on a white slide, failing WCAG contrast
misconceptions.feedback: Check text against background for at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text; adjust the darker or lighter value.

misconceptions.description: Adding images and charts with no alternative text for screen readers
misconceptions.trigger: learner inserts a chart image with no alt text describing the trend
misconceptions.feedback: Write alt text that states what the image shows and its point, so a screen-reader user gets the same information.

misconceptions.description: Encoding meaning with color alone so colorblind viewers lose it
misconceptions.trigger: learner marks 'pass' green and 'fail' red with no label or shape difference
misconceptions.feedback: Pair color with a label, icon, or pattern so the meaning survives without color perception.
